description.en: Apply for a new water and/or sewer connection (Chennai Metrowater).
description.ta: புதிய குடிநீர் மற்றும்/அல்லது கழிவுநீர் இணைப்புக்கு விண்ணப்பிக்க (சென்னை மெட்ரோவாட்டர்).
description.hi: नए पानी और/या सीवर कनेक्शन का आवेदन (चेन्नई मेट्रोवाटर)।
description.or: ନୂଆ ପାଣି ଓ/ବା ସିୱର ସଂଯୋଗ ଆବେଦନ (ଚେନ୍ନାଇ ମେଟ୍ରୋୱାଟର)।

submit_note: Apply online on the Chennai Metrowater website or at the depot office for your area. Charges depend on building size and usage.

question.en: What is the full address of the property?

fields.explain: Address of the building that needs the connection.

question.en: What is the property tax assessment number? (on your property tax receipt)

fields.explain: The number on your Corporation property tax receipt. It links the connection to the right property.
Water supply brings drinking water; sewer connection takes waste water to the city drainage.
Commercial and mixed-use buildings pay different charges.

question.en: How many floors does the building have (including ground floor)?
How many separate houses or flats are in the building?
What is the total built-up area in square feet?

fields.explain: Total covered area of all floors.
